name: Shelomith
overview: Shelomith was a male descendant of Bani, identified as the son of Josiphiah. He is noted in Scripture specifically for his association with the group that returned to Jerusalem with Ezra. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shelomith means 'at peace' in Hebrew. This proper name is recorded without indication that it was given directly by God, and it appears in Ezra 8:10.
familyAndRelationships: Shelomith is explicitly identified as the son of Josiphiah. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family connections or relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Shelomith's significance lies in his role as a returning exile with Ezra, marking him as part of the faithful remnant who came back to Jerusalem during the post-exilic restoration. His lineage, as a descendant of Bani and son of Josiphiah, ties him to the community involved in the covenant renewal and rebuilding efforts under Ezra's leadership. This connection highlights the continuity of God's people returning to their land and faithfulness to His covenant.
